name: Outage fallback
optimizes: Provider outages and 5xx errors fail over to a backup chain instead of erroring the caller.
description: Keep traffic flowing when a provider is degraded. The primary stays gpt-4o, but on a fallback-eligible failure (provider down, 5xx, timeout) the gateway retries the ordered fallback chain — first a same-class alternative, then a cheaper, widely-available model. Fallbacks may cross providers.
